claim: Ancestral lineage becomes less informative about realised ecological behaviour under mutation and HGT.
evidence_required: Versioned factorial runs; individual behavioural divergence; lineage-informativeness metric; uncertainty across independent runs

claim: Mutation rate affects the onset and magnitude of lineage–behaviour divergence.
evidence_required: Controlled mutation factor with independent runs and HGT held/varied; effect sizes and intervals

claim: HGT success probability affects the onset and magnitude of lineage–behaviour divergence.
evidence_required: Controlled HGT factor with independent runs and mutation held/varied; proof transferred code is expressed
current_evidence: No configurable HGT-success experiment in legacy engine

claim: Mutation and HGT interact in determining classification failure.
evidence_required: Factorial interaction estimate with run-level replication and uncertainty

claim: A behavioural dual-classification framework is more informative than lineage labels alone.
evidence_required: Out-of-sample prediction or information metric; cross-classification; sensitivity analysis
current_evidence: Legacy cross-counts only; legacy divergence index is unsuitable

claim: TIERRA-SIM is deterministic for a fixed engine version, configuration, and seed.
evidence_required: Automated reproducibility tests comparing full state/output hashes across repeated runs
current_evidence: 24 run pairs sharing conditions and seeds across two independently executed batches agreed exactly on Delta_D and all population counts at 888/888 matched samples over their common prefix (2 Aug 2026). State hashes differ by design because the hash binds state to configuration_id; see D046.

evidence_required: Demonstrate a constrained benefit to caller and measurable cost/resource transfer from neighbour; compare fitness
current_evidence: Validated rebuild transfers offspring energy and exploit levy from the selected donor; v7 records caller births and donor costs under both compatibility rules; formal fitness evidence is absent

claim: Stable mixed or mixotrophic strategies emerge.
evidence_required: Longitudinal individual behaviour; persistence; transition rates; frequency perturbation; independent runs
current_evidence: Legacy genome-presence counts and end states

claim: Negative frequency-dependent selection maintains mixed strategies.
evidence_required: Direct fitness-versus-frequency estimates or perturbation/recovery experiments
current_evidence: Narrative interpretation and cross-run correlations only

evidence_required: Execution traces showing valid input/output transformations; ancestry of evolved circuits; reward sensitivity controls
current_evidence: Reward-gated computation with input provenance and once-per-cycle accounting is implemented and construct-tested; no formal evolutionary evidence exists

claim: The legacy system converged near a 71/25/4 functional composition.
evidence_required: Original raw data and scripts; reproduction in rebuilt engine if retained as relevant
current_evidence: End-state tables in exploratory thesis; raw datasets not present

evidence_required: Manipulation of NOP density controlling genome length/COPY density; fitness or exploitation-success measurement

claim: COPY instructions behave as selfish genetic elements.
evidence_required: Within-genome transmission advantage separable from organism fitness; mechanistic analysis
current_evidence: COPY redundancy benefits organism replication under legacy cooldown

evidence_required: Persistent heritable multimodal strategies; temporal stability; ecological/fitness differentiation; direct modality testing
current_evidence: Functional categories and high variance only

claim: Spatial structure enables or changes diversification.
evidence_required: Non-spatial or alternative-neighbourhood control with otherwise identical engine and protocol
